project_name: Willets Point Phase II Mapping Actions
project_brief: An amendment to the City Map, in conjunction with related actions (record number 2023Q0251), to facilitate a new 25,000 seat soccer-specific stadium, four predominantly residential buildings and a hotel is being sought by EDC, New York City Football Club, Related, and Sterling Equities for a site located in Willets Point, Community District 7, Queens.
primary_applicant: EDC - Economic Development Corporation for NYC

project_brief: The applicant, Le Grande Boucherie, seeks a zoning text amendment, a modification to a previously approved CPC Certification (M 880194 B ZCM), and a Chairperson's certification pursuant to ZR 81-231(b). These actions will facilitate private cafe use within the Through Block Galleria (POPS) at 1325 Avenue of The Americas.
